            _PLAN.clear()
        _PLAN[pkey] = plan
    # The reference writes in place and returns the same tensor.  This
    # implementation must return a distinct tensor, and a contiguous one: a
    # strided ``self`` (e.g. ``base[..., 0]``) has gaps that a flat store would
    # otherwise leave as uninitialised memory.
    out = torch.empty(self.shape, dtype=self.dtype, device=self.device)
    n = plan[0]
    if n == 0:
        return out
    block, grid, lo, hi, span = plan[1], plan[2], plan[3], plan[4], plan[5]
    get_seed, get_off, set_off = _gen_state(self.device, generator)
    seed = get_seed()
    offset = get_off()
    # Advance by exactly the counters this call consumes, so replaying from a
    # saved state reproduces the draw and later calls continue the stream.
    set_off(offset + n)
    execute = plan[6]
    if execute is not None:
        try:
            execute(out, n, _w(offset), _key(seed, offset), self.device.index or 0)
            return out
        except Exception:
            plan[6] = None
    key = _key(seed, offset)
    kern = uniform_kernel[(grid,)](out, n, _w(offset), key, from_, span, lo, hi, BLOCK=block)
    try:
        plan[6] = _direct(kern, block, grid, from_, span, lo, hi)
    except Exception:
        plan[6] = None
    return out
